en_title: Arkane Lyon Reportedly Could Be Closed in Mid-November if a Buyer Isn't Found, With Marvel's Blade Still in Development
cn_title: 《漫威刀锋战士》据报Arkane里昂无买家或关闭
subtitle: 悬在217人头顶的利剑
opus_summary: 据报，Arkane里昂若未找到买家，可能于11月中旬关闭，217名员工仍在开发《漫威刀锋战士》。工会正争取延长期限，微软表示仍在寻找合作伙伴。

paragraphs.en: Arkane Lyon is still working on Marvel’s Blade, but it’s doing it with the Sword of Damocles dangling over the heads of its 217 employees.
paragraphs.cn: Arkane里昂仍在开发《漫威刀锋战士》，但工作室的217名员工头顶都悬着一把达摩克利斯之剑。

paragraphs.en: According to French outlet Le Monde , Florange Law, adopted in 2014 in France, requires companies with more than 1,000 employees to search for a buyer for at least three months before closing a studio. According to the report, the search for a buyer for the Dishonored 2 and Deathloop developer began in the summer, meaning the deadline is imminent — November 13.
paragraphs.cn: 据法国媒体《世界报》报道，法国于2014年通过的《弗洛朗日法》规定，员工超过1,000人的企业在关闭工作室前，必须先花至少三个月寻找买家。报道称，这家开发了《耻辱2》和《死亡循环》的工作室从夏季开始寻找买家，期限即将于11月13日届满。

paragraphs.en: The studio was informed of Microsoft’s decision on July 16, shortly after new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced closure or spinoff plans for Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs — Ninja Theory was closed while the other studios went independent, taking their franchises with them. Over 1,600 jobs were affected across Microsoft's gaming business at the time. More have followed, and more are set to follow still.
paragraphs.cn: 工作室于7月16日获知微软的决定。不久前，XBOX新任首席执行官Asha Sharma宣布，计划关闭或剥离Compulsion Games、Double Fine Productions、Ninja Theory和Undead Labs。其中，Ninja Theory已关闭，其余工作室则带着各自的系列作品独立运营。当时，微软游戏业务有超过1,600个岗位受到影响。此后又有更多岗位受到波及，接下来还会继续增加。

paragraphs.en: According to Le Monde, a union rep said that "negotiations on the redundancy plan are going badly” at Arkane Lyon, which Microsoft picked up when it bought Bethesda owner ZeniMax in 2021. The worker unions are currently trying to buy more time "to give the discussions a better chance of reaching a conclusion."
paragraphs.cn: 据《世界报》报道，一名工会代表表示，Arkane里昂的「裁员方案谈判进展不顺」。微软于2021年收购贝塞斯达母公司ZeniMax时，将这家工作室收入旗下。目前，员工工会正设法争取更多时间，「让讨论更有机会达成结果」。

paragraphs.en: “Several forms of takeover are being considered,” according to the report, which suggests buyers are interested in the immersive sim studio. That’s why the union is pushing for more time and is “hopeful of saving the studio and its jobs.”
paragraphs.cn: 报道称，「目前正在考虑多种接手方案」，这表明有买家对这家沉浸式模拟游戏工作室感兴趣。因此，工会正争取更多时间，并「对保住工作室及其岗位抱有希望」。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft didn’t respond directly to the report but sent the following statement: "We continue to explore different options for Arkane as part of the ongoing French consultation process. We are keeping the works council and employees informed and are actively seeking a partner to support the next phase of development and enable the commercialization of the project."
paragraphs.cn: 微软没有直接回应这篇报道，但发来了以下声明：「法国的协商程序仍在进行，我们也在这一过程中继续探索Arkane的不同方案。我们持续向职工委员会和员工通报情况，并积极寻找合作伙伴，以支持下一阶段的开发，让项目得以商业化。」

paragraphs.en: An internal document seen by Le Monde stated that "the implementation of the project [for the complete and definitive cessation of the company's activities] is scheduled to begin at the end of 2026 and should extend into the first quarter of 2027."
paragraphs.cn: 《世界报》看到的一份内部文件写道：「该计划〔即全面、永久终止公司业务的计划〕定于2026年底开始实施，预计将持续至2027年第一季度。」

paragraphs.en: The union is currently pushing for re-employment of affected staff to other studios within Xbox. "The redundancy plan must be adapted to the video game market where, currently, the prospects for returning to work are extremely limited,” said the rep.
paragraphs.cn: 工会目前正争取让受影响员工转岗至XBOX旗下其他工作室。这名代表表示：「裁员方案必须考虑到电子游戏就业市场的实际情况。目前，员工重新就业的机会极其有限。」

paragraphs.en: Negotiations are ongoing until October 30, but the union hasn’t ruled out seeing Microsoft in court. “This is in complete contradiction with what we've been told in the Works Council for years about the company's financial situation," the rep said. "Microsoft is looking to divest itself of Arkane, even though the studio is doing well, in order to save money and improve the profitability of its short-term investments."
paragraphs.cn: 谈判将持续至10月30日，但工会并未排除与微软对簿公堂的可能。这名代表表示：「多年来，我们在职工委员会获知的公司财务状况与此完全矛盾。尽管工作室经营良好，微软仍打算剥离Arkane，以节省开支，提高短期投资的盈利能力。」

paragraphs.en: Through all of this is concern that Marvel's Blade may never see the light of day. IGN understands that prior to the layoffs in July, Blade was on track for a reveal early next year and a release in the fourth quarter of 2027. IGN has asked Marvel Games for comment but it has failed to respond.
paragraphs.cn: 这一切也让人担忧，《漫威刀锋战士》可能永远无法面世。据IGN了解，在7月裁员前，《漫威刀锋战士》的进度符合计划，原定于明年年初展示，并于2027年第四季度发售。IGN已向Marvel Games寻求置评，但对方未作回应。

paragraphs.en: Blade was announced in December 2023 with a reveal trailer, but we've seen nothing of it since. In June, Bethesda Game Studios head Todd Howard was quoted as saying he'd recently seen what Arkane Lyon was cooking up and was impressed . "I'm not at liberty to say when [we'll see more]," Howard teased at the time, "but I saw some stuff just yesterday [on May 21] and the folks at Arkane [Studios, the developers] are doing a really, really great job."
paragraphs.cn: 《漫威刀锋战士》于2023年12月公布，并发布了首支预告片，但此后一直没有展示新内容。6月，有报道援引贝塞斯达游戏工作室负责人陶德·霍华德的话称，他最近看过Arkane里昂正在开发的内容，印象深刻。霍华德当时卖了个关子：「我不便透露（我们何时能看到更多），」「但我昨天（5月21日）刚看到一些内容，Arkane（工作室，开发商）的伙计们干得真的非常、非常出色。」
